title: Pinata Pricing: Plans and Costs in 2026
summary: Pinata pricing structures dictate your monthly storage and bandwidth expenses for IPFS hosting. Select the appropriate tier based on your data volume.
body_markdown:
## How Pinata pricing stacks up against IPFS alternatives


Pinata commands a price premium because it bundles dedicated gateway performance with storage. Competitors often treat retrieval as a metered secondary service.


### The storage-first approach of Web3.Storage


Web3.Storage offers a different value proposition by prioritizing verifiable cryptographic proofs of storage over immediate, low-latency retrieval. Their pricing model is often more attractive for massive archival projects where the primary goal is long-term data integrity on Filecoin rather than high-speed media delivery.


If your application does not require a dedicated CDN for every request, the raw cost per gigabyte on Web3.Storage can be significantly lower.


It is a reasonable choice for developers who are comfortable managing their own retrieval layers or who are building decentralized archives that prioritize cost-efficiency over millisecond response times.


### Using Pinata alongside Infura's Ethereum tools


For those already using Ethereum API services, Infura (a blockchain infrastructure suite managed by Consensys) provides a unified dashboard. It is an excellent choice for developers who want to consolidate their web3 stack under one vendor and one billing cycle.


While it requires more manual configuration to optimize gateway speeds compared to Pinata's turnkey solution, Infura offers deep integration with other developer tools.


This makes it a strong contender for teams building complex dApps that need a reliable, all-in-one infrastructure provider for both blockchain data and IPFS storage.


Activepieces bridges the gap for teams who need to automate these file uploads to Pinata's API without writing custom multipart/form-data scripts.


The published pricing page shows 1 credit per flow run regardless of the number of steps, which avoids the cost penalties found in Zapier's per-task or Make's per-module billing.


Deployment on Activepieces is a setting, not a commitment. A flow built on managed cloud and a flow built self-hosted run on the same codebase, allowing teams to promote or move logic between environments as their data residency needs change.


Activepieces ships the same product either way (RBAC, SSO, SCIM and audit logs included on cloud and self-hosted alike) as documented in the Git Sync and Releases feature list.


### Pinata versus other IPFS pinning services


Pinata's entry tier is a controlled environment for testing small-scale deployments, but its utility is defined by its strict limits on the number of individual files pinned.


Pinata offers a streamlined SDK and API that automates the "pinning" process, reducing the lines of code required to ensure data persistence.
